criteria.note: WHITESPACE_ALLOWLIST (test:4606-4627) maps each of the 20 functions to a reason constant (MARKDOWN or NORMALISED, test:4603-4605). criteria.description: A test fails if the substitution scan is made recursive again
criteria.note: The test at test:5025 tokenizes and classifies a 20000-deep nest. It asserts doesNotThrow, 20000 subst tokens and a 3 s bound. A recursive scan overflows the stack at that depth. QA 4 line 16 records the mutation: recursion added to openSubst turns this test red (1 red). The earlier advisory that no mutation run existed is closed.
